service_boundary: Represents the SeekrFlow inference API at flow.seekr.com, not the SeekrFlow development platform (agents, data engine, fine-tuning, deployments UI), the Python and JavaScript SDKs, or the seekrflow agent runtime record.
regional_controls: The reviewed reference exposes one global base URL and no customer-selected inference region.
retention_controls: The reviewed terms and privacy pages state no request-data retention period, no training-use commitment, and no zero-retention option.
routing: Customers address their own deployments on the single Seekr endpoint and select the model per request; the API routes no request to an external provider.
customization: Customers fine-tune (instruction, GRPO, context-grounded) and deploy their own checkpoints to dedicated endpoints; the reviewed pages document no shared multi-tenant serving tier.
strengths: Full OpenAPI reference with per-operation pages, batch inference jobs with queue and status, and health endpoints.
Deployments provision dedicated compute per model with pause and delete lifecycle.
Model catalog reports identifier, type, country of origin, and inference availability per model.
tradeoffs: Customer deployments only: no shared serving tier, no regions, no training-use or retention commitments found on the reviewed pages.
Inference serves what the customer deploys; catalog breadth beyond the deployment model is not established.
No public vulnerability-disclosure process and no published audit found on the reviewed pages.

response_integrity.note: The reference documents answers with confidence and token usage per request, but no signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism tying a result back to the model run appears on the reviewed pages.
response_integrity.scope: SeekrFlow API reference, for the SeekrFlow API

upstream_disclosure.note: The caller names the deployed model per request, and the model catalog reports each model's identifier, type, and country of origin; no subprocessor is named on the reviewed pages.
upstream_disclosure.scope: SeekrFlow model catalog, for the SeekrFlow API

credential_handling.note: The reference authenticates with a Seekr API key sent in the Authorization header with no Bearer prefix.
credential_handling.scope: SeekrFlow API reference, for the SeekrFlow API

cache_isolation.note: No per-customer isolation, tenancy, or cache-separation statement appears on the reviewed documentation, terms, or policy pages.
cache_isolation.scope: SeekrFlow documentation and legal pages, for the SeekrFlow API

vulnerability_disclosure.note: No security contact, disclosure process, or coordinated-vulnerability policy appears on the reviewed pages.
vulnerability_disclosure.scope: SeekrFlow documentation and site pages, for the SeekrFlow API

independent_audit.note: No audit report, attestation, or compliance certification appears on the reviewed pages.
independent_audit.scope: SeekrFlow documentation and site pages, for the SeekrFlow API
